Container.Name: Pley
Container.Overview: Pley: your movies, shows and music, and live TV, streamed to the web, phones, TVs, Kodi and Roku. It plays files as they are when a device can, and transcodes on the GPU when it can't (Intel Quick Sync, AMD, NVIDIA NVENC), HDR tone mapping included.[br][br]Once it has started, open the WebUI and create the administrator account with the setup code from Pley's log (the Pley icon, Logs).
Container.Requires: **Hardware transcoding** (optional). Intel or AMD: add a Device, `/dev/dri`. NVIDIA: the Nvidia Driver plugin, `--runtime=nvidia` in Extra Parameters, and the GPU's UUID in NVIDIA GPU.

Config.Name: Web UI
Config.Description: The web app, and the address the apps connect to.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Pley's database, artwork and caches: the only folder it writes. Back it up.

Config.Name: Media
Config.Description: Your media share, read-only. In Pley, libraries are folders under /media, such as /media/Movies.

Config.Name: NVIDIA GPU
Config.Description: NVIDIA only: the GPU's UUID from the Nvidia Driver plugin's page, or all. Also add --runtime=nvidia to Extra Parameters.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: The user Pley runs as: 99 is Unraid's nobody, who owns appdata and reads the shares.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: The group Pley runs in: 100 is Unraid's users.

Config.Name: Log level
Config.Description: info, or debug to look into a problem.
